A11Y_FORM_LABEL_MISSING.fix: Associate a label with the control, or provide a valid aria-label or aria-labelledby reference.
A11Y_FORM_LABEL_MISSING.message: Form control has no static accessible label

A11Y_HEADING_ORDER.fix: Review the heading outline and use nested heading levels consistently.
A11Y_HEADING_ORDER.message: Heading sequence skips a level in the static document

A11Y_HTML_LANG_MISSING.fix: Declare the document language on html and review whether it matches the content.
A11Y_HTML_LANG_MISSING.message: Root html element has no nonempty lang declaration

A11Y_IMAGE_ALT_MISSING.fix: Provide meaningful alternative text; explicitly mark decorative images with empty alt text.
A11Y_IMAGE_ALT_MISSING.message: Image has no alt attribute or static accessible name

A11Y_MAIN_LANDMARK_MISSING.fix: Mark the primary page content with main or role=main and verify navigation with assistive technology.
A11Y_MAIN_LANDMARK_MISSING.message: Document content has no main landmark

AJAX_CRAWLING_SCHEME_META_FRAGMENT.fix: Remove the tag once the page is served as ordinary HTML (server-rendered or crawlable client-rendered). Nothing requests the _escaped_fragment_ companion URL it advertises any more, so the declaration is inert -- informational rather than broken.
AJAX_CRAWLING_SCHEME_META_FRAGMENT.message: Page declares <meta name="fragment"> -- the page-wide opt-in to the deprecated AJAX crawling scheme

AJAX_CRAWLING_SCHEME_URL.fix: Serve the same content at ordinary URLs and link to those instead. Google deprecated the scheme in 2015 and stopped supporting it in 2018, so an _escaped_fragment_ companion URL is no longer requested by anything -- informational rather than broken, because a site may still keep it for a legacy client of its own.
AJAX_CRAWLING_SCHEME_URL.message: The deprecated AJAX crawling scheme (#! / _escaped_fragment_) is still used by this page's URL or by URLs it links to

AMPHTML_PRESENT.fix: Confirm that the AMP version is still required, current, valid, and canonically linked.

AMP_BOILERPLATE_INVALID.fix: Include the head style[amp-boilerplate] rules and the noscript fallback on the page the pairing declares.
AMP_BOILERPLATE_INVALID.message: The AMP page declared by rel=amphtml lacks the AMP boilerplate declarations

AMP_INDEXABLE.fix: Confirm the AMP page should compete in search; if the non-AMP page is canonical, the AMP page usually should not be.

AMP_INVALID_BOILERPLATE.fix: Include the required amp-boilerplate style and noscript fallback; validate their content with the official AMP validator.
AMP_INVALID_BOILERPLATE.message: AMP document lacks the structural AMP boilerplate declarations

AMP_INVALID_CHARSET.fix: Place <meta charset="utf-8"> first in the AMP head.
AMP_INVALID_CHARSET.message: AMP head does not start with the required UTF-8 charset declaration

AMP_INVALID_DOCTYPE.fix: Start the AMP source document with <!doctype html>.
AMP_INVALID_DOCTYPE.message: AMP document has a missing or invalid HTML5 doctype

AMP_INVALID_RUNTIME.fix: Add <script async src="https://cdn.ampproject.org/v0.js"></script> to the AMP head.
AMP_INVALID_RUNTIME.message: AMP document lacks an async AMP runtime script in the head

AMP_INVALID_VIEWPORT.fix: Declare a viewport containing width=device-width in the head.
AMP_INVALID_VIEWPORT.message: AMP document lacks the required device-width viewport

AMP_MISSING_BODY.fix: Include an explicit body element in the AMP source.
AMP_MISSING_BODY.message: AMP source document has no explicit body element

AMP_MISSING_CANONICAL.fix: Add a rel=canonical on the AMP page that points to the non-AMP version.
AMP_MISSING_CANONICAL.message: The AMP page declares no rel=canonical

AMP_MISSING_HEAD.fix: Include an explicit head element in the AMP source.
AMP_MISSING_HEAD.message: AMP source document has no explicit head element

AMP_MISSING_HTML_ATTRIBUTE.fix: Add the AMP attribute to the root html element, or correct the rel=amphtml target.
AMP_MISSING_HTML_ATTRIBUTE.message: AMP target does not declare the html amp or lightning attribute

AMP_MISSING_RETURN_LINK.fix: Point the AMP page's rel=canonical at the non-AMP URL that declares rel=amphtml.
AMP_MISSING_RETURN_LINK.message: The AMP page's rel=canonical does not point back to the page that declares it

AMP_NON_200.fix: Serve the AMP URL with 200, or remove the rel=amphtml declaration that names it.
AMP_NON_200.message: The AMP page declared by rel=amphtml does not answer 200

AMP_NON_INDEXABLE_CANONICAL.fix: Make the canonical target indexable, or correct the AMP page's rel=canonical.
AMP_NON_INDEXABLE_CANONICAL.message: The AMP page's canonical target is not indexable

AMP_SCRIPT_MISSING.fix: Add <script async src="https://cdn.ampproject.org/v0.js"></script> to the head of the page the pairing declares.
AMP_SCRIPT_MISSING.message: The AMP page declared by rel=amphtml has no AMP runtime script in its head

ASSET_SHORT_CACHE.fix: Use an appropriate public max-age for versioned static assets; keep private and no-store policies where required.
ASSET_SHORT_CACHE.message: A captured resource has no long-lived public cache policy

BAD_REDIRECT_TYPE.fix: Use a 301 redirect when the move is permanent.
BAD_REDIRECT_TYPE.message: Temporary redirect (302, 303 or 307) used where a permanent redirect is expected

BLOCKED_BY_ROBOTS.fix: Confirm that the block is intentional; pages intended for indexing should remain crawlable.

BODY_MIME_MISMATCH.fix: Serve the resource with a Content-Type that matches its body, or return the intended body.
BODY_MIME_MISMATCH.message: Retained response body does not match its declared Content-Type

BODY_MISSING.fix: Add a <body> element; a browser inserts one implicitly around the visible content.

BODY_MULTIPLE.fix: Merge into a single <body>; a browser keeps both as siblings rather than combining their contents.
BODY_MULTIPLE.message: Document has more than one <body> element

BOUNCE_RATE_ABOVE_70.fix: Review the measured URL and its traffic source; bounce rate is a diagnostic signal, not a ranking verdict.
BOUNCE_RATE_ABOVE_70.message: Yandex Metrika reports a bounce rate above 70 percent

BROKEN_BOOKMARK.fix: Point the href at an element id or <a name> that exists in the destination document, or add the missing target; a different query string is a different document.
BROKEN_BOOKMARK.message: Link fragment identifies no element on the destination page

BROKEN_EXTERNAL_LINK.fix: Update or remove the broken external link, while accounting for sites that intentionally return 403 responses to crawlers.
BROKEN_EXTERNAL_LINK.message: External link points to a 4xx or 5xx URL

BROKEN_INTERNAL_LINK.fix: Update the link to the current URL or add an appropriate 301 redirect; if it appears in the footer or navigation, fix the shared template.
BROKEN_INTERNAL_LINK.message: Internal link points to a 4xx URL

BROKEN_PAGE_4XX.fix: Restore the page or redirect it with a 301 to a relevant URL; remove or update links that point to it.

CANONICALISED.fix: Confirm that cross-canonicalization is intentional and that the target is the preferred version.
CANONICALISED.message: Canonical points to a different URL

CANONICAL_CHAIN.fix: Point the canonical directly to the final canonical URL in one step and break any canonical loops.
CANONICAL_CHAIN.message: Canonical chain: the target canonicalizes to another URL (two or more steps)

CANONICAL_CROSS_ORIGIN.fix: Confirm that cross-host or protocol consolidation is intentional and that the target is the preferred URL.
CANONICAL_CROSS_ORIGIN.message: Canonical changes the declaring URL host or protocol

CANONICAL_FRAGMENT.fix: Drop the fragment; the server never receives it, so a canonical pointing at one is meaningless.

CANONICAL_HOMEPAGE_GROUP.fix: Review each listed page's canonical. Use a self-canonical for distinct indexable content, or configure an explicit pagination/filter policy when a landing canonical is intentional.
CANONICAL_HOMEPAGE_GROUP.message: Distinct indexable pages in multiple sections canonicalize to the homepage

CANONICAL_INVALID_ATTRIBUTE.fix: Remove hreflang, lang, media and type from the canonical link; declare alternates separately. Use an HTML whitespace-separated canonical relation and a non-empty HTTP(S) href. Raw attributes are included in the evidence.
CANONICAL_INVALID_ATTRIBUTE.message: Canonical annotation contains unsupported alternate-version attributes or malformed rel/href

CANONICAL_MISMATCH.fix: Declare one stable canonical URL in the original response.
CANONICAL_MISMATCH.message: Canonical URL changes after JavaScript rendering

CANONICAL_MISSING.message: Indexable page has no canonical URL

CANONICAL_MULTIPLE.fix: Declare exactly one canonical URL for the page.

CANONICAL_NON_INDEXABLE.fix: Point the canonical to an indexable preferred version.
CANONICAL_NON_INDEXABLE.message: Canonical points to a non-indexable URL

CANONICAL_ONLY_IN_RENDERED_HTML.fix: Declare the canonical URL in the original response.
CANONICAL_ONLY_IN_RENDERED_HTML.message: Canonical URL is present only after JavaScript rendering

CANONICAL_OUTSIDE_HEAD.fix: Move whatever precedes it in <head> — usually an element the head content model does not allow — so the canonical is read from <head> again; Google ignores a canonical outside <head>.
CANONICAL_OUTSIDE_HEAD.message: The canonical link is outside <head> once the parser resolves the document

CANONICAL_RELATIVE.fix: Use an absolute URL in the canonical element.

CANONICAL_TARGET_ERROR.fix: Point the canonical to a fetched, successful URL; restore the target or redirect it to the intended canonical page.
CANONICAL_TARGET_ERROR.message: Canonical points to a URL returning 4xx or 5xx

CANONICAL_TO_REDIRECT.fix: Point the canonical to the final 200-status URL; otherwise search engines must resolve conflicting canonical signals.
CANONICAL_TO_REDIRECT.message: Canonical points to a redirecting URL (3xx)

CONTENT_IN_IFRAME.fix: Serve the framed copy in the page's own HTML. A search engine attributes an iframe's text to the framed document, not to the page that frames it, so the copy exists and earns this URL nothing.
CONTENT_IN_IFRAME.message: The page's content sits inside an iframe and is not attributed to this URL

DECLARED_MIME_MISMATCH.fix: Confirm the response Content-Type and URL extension describe the intended resource; this is a declaration consistency signal, not full MIME validation.
DECLARED_MIME_MISMATCH.message: Received Content-Type conflicts with an unambiguous URL filename extension

DEEP_CLICK_DEPTH.fix: Link the page from a hub, category or related page nearer the start URL. A page linked only by a chain of next-post links is reachable and still effectively invisible, which no orphan count reports.
DEEP_CLICK_DEPTH.message: The page is more clicks from the crawl's start URL than the configured floor

DEEP_CRAWL_DEPTH.fix: Use relevant internal links to make the page reachable in fewer clicks from the home page or an authoritative hub.

DEEP_DISCOVERY_PATH.fix: Add a shorter internal-linking route (e.g. from a hub or category page) so the page is reachable in fewer clicks.
DEEP_DISCOVERY_PATH.message: The shortest hyperlink route from the start page exceeds the configured depth

DESC_DUPLICATE.fix: Write a unique meta description for each page.

DESC_MISSING.fix: Add a useful meta description, typically up to about 160 characters.

DESC_MULTIPLE.fix: Keep exactly one meta description element; a search engine reads only the first, so the rest are dead weight that hides which value is actually live.
DESC_MULTIPLE.message: More than one <meta name="description"> element is present

DESC_OUTSIDE_HEAD.fix: Move whatever precedes it in <head> — usually an element the head content model does not allow — so the description is read from <head> again.
DESC_OUTSIDE_HEAD.message: The meta description is outside <head> once the parser resolves the document

DESC_PIXELS_BELOW.fix: Expand the description so it uses the available SERP width informatively.
DESC_PIXELS_BELOW.message: Meta description falls below the configured SERP pixel-width threshold

DESC_PIXELS_OVER.fix: Shorten the description; SERP truncation follows rendered pixel width, not the character count.
DESC_PIXELS_OVER.message: Meta description exceeds the configured SERP pixel-width threshold

DESC_TOO_LONG.fix: Shorten the description while preserving its primary value proposition.
DESC_TOO_LONG.message: Meta description exceeds the configured length threshold

DESC_TOO_SHORT.fix: Expand the description with specific, useful page information.
DESC_TOO_SHORT.message: Meta description falls below the configured length threshold

DIRECTIVES_OUTSIDE_HEAD.fix: Move whatever precedes it in <head> — usually an element the head content model does not allow — so the directive is read from <head> again; a noindex/nofollow outside <head> does not apply.
DIRECTIVES_OUTSIDE_HEAD.message: A robots-directive meta tag is outside <head> once the parser resolves the document

DOM_TOO_DEEP.fix: Simplify the layout hierarchy and remove unnecessary wrapper elements.

DOM_TOO_MANY_NODES.fix: Reduce the number of page elements and avoid rendering unnecessary or duplicated components.

DUPLICATED_JS.fix: Load the identical script once; review the build and page template.
DUPLICATED_JS.message: Different script URLs on one page contain identical captured source bytes

DUPLICATE_BY_HASH.fix: Consolidate duplicates with canonicalization or rewrite them to serve distinct search intent.

DUPLICATE_ID.fix: Give each element its own id; duplicate ids make fragment targets, scripts, and accessibility relationships ambiguous.
DUPLICATE_ID.message: HTML id value is repeated in the parsed document

DUPLICATE_INTERNAL_LINK.fix: Emit the block once. A layout element rendered twice (one copy hidden by CSS or removed by JavaScript) duplicates every link it contains, which inflates the internal link graph without adding a single new route.
DUPLICATE_INTERNAL_LINK.message: The page repeats the same link -- same destination, same anchor text -- more than once

DUPLICATE_SECURITY_HEADER.fix: Send each security header once. A repeated header can be ignored or applied next to the other copy, so the policy the browser enforces may not be the one intended.
DUPLICATE_SECURITY_HEADER.message: HTML page sends a security header more than once

EXTERNAL_LINK_TO_REDIRECT.fix: This is often acceptable for external sites; optionally update the link to point directly to the final URL.
EXTERNAL_LINK_TO_REDIRECT.message: External link points to a redirect (3xx)

EXTERNAL_NOFOLLOW.fix: Confirm each external nofollow link is intentional. Keep nofollow (or rel=sponsored/rel=ugc) on paid placements and user-generated content; an editorial link you vouch for does not need it.
EXTERNAL_NOFOLLOW.message: The page has external outlinks marked nofollow

EXTERNAL_NO_RESPONSE.fix: Review the recorded timeout or connection failure and update or remove the link after confirming the destination is unavailable.
EXTERNAL_NO_RESPONSE.message: An explicitly checked external destination did not answer

FEW_CITATIONS.fix: Review whether the page should cite its sources. An outbound link inside the body copy is the only carrier a crawl can observe as a citation; the finding never asserts that any link is authoritative.
FEW_CITATIONS.message: Content-shaped page has no observable outbound reference in its body content

FILTER_CANONICAL_POLICY.fix: Review the canonical against the configured filter policy; the expected target is included in the evidence.
FILTER_CANONICAL_POLICY.message: Filtered URL canonical does not match the configured project policy

FOLLOW_AND_NOFOLLOW_INLINKS.fix: Decide deliberately whether the page should be crawl-priority or not, and make every internal link to it agree.
FOLLOW_AND_NOFOLLOW_INLINKS.message: The page receives both a followed and a nofollow internal link

FONT_DISPLAY_MISSING.fix: Set font-display to swap, fallback or optional when appropriate for the font.
FONT_DISPLAY_MISSING.message: An observed stylesheet font-face lacks an accepted font-display value

FORCED_REFLOW.fix: Review the measured script stack and batch layout reads and writes.
FORCED_REFLOW.message: The supplied Lighthouse forced-reflow audit reports an opportunity

FORM_ON_HTTP_URL.fix: Serve the page itself over HTTPS; an HTTPS form action does not protect input typed on an HTTP page.
FORM_ON_HTTP_URL.message: A form with a password field is served from a plain-HTTP page, so the credentials themselves travel unencrypted before the action URL is even reached

FORM_URL_INSECURE.fix: Point the form's action at an https:// URL.
FORM_URL_INSECURE.message: A form submits to an http:// action, so its data leaves the browser unencrypted regardless of the page's own scheme

GA_ORPHAN_URL.fix: Check whether the URL is intentionally retired, blocked, redirected, or missing from the crawl population.
GA_ORPHAN_URL.message: GA4 reports a landing URL absent from the crawl

GENERIC_ANCHOR_TEXT.fix: Replace it with meaningful anchor text that describes the destination for both search engines and screen-reader users.
GENERIC_ANCHOR_TEXT.message: Non-descriptive anchor text such as 'here', 'read more', or 'click here'

GRAMMAR_ERRORS.fix: Review and correct the flagged grammar issues in their full sentence context.

GSC_AMP_INVALID.fix: Review the AMP inspection result and repair or remove obsolete AMP markup.
GSC_AMP_INVALID.message: Search Console reports an invalid AMP result

GSC_INDEXABLE_NOT_INDEXED.fix: Review Search Console's coverage state, canonical, fetch state, and indexing directives.
GSC_INDEXABLE_NOT_INDEXED.message: Crawl reports an indexable URL that Search Console does not index

GSC_INDEXED_WITH_ISSUES.fix: Review the specific AMP or rich-result inspection evidence for the sampled URL.
GSC_INDEXED_WITH_ISSUES.message: Search Console reports an indexed URL with AMP or rich-result issues

GSC_ORPHAN.fix: Check the retained page and crawl scope, then restore, redirect, or remove the URL from search when appropriate.
GSC_ORPHAN.message: Search Console reports impressions for a same-origin URL absent from the crawl

GSC_RICH_RESULTS_INVALID.fix: Review the inspected rich-result item and correct errors reported by Search Console.
GSC_RICH_RESULTS_INVALID.message: Search Console reports invalid structured data for a rich result

GSC_URL_NOT_ON_GOOGLE.fix: Review the sampled URL's Search Console coverage state and correct blocking or canonical issues where appropriate.
GSC_URL_NOT_ON_GOOGLE.message: Search Console reports that the inspected URL is not on Google

GSC_USER_CANONICAL_NOT_SELECTED.fix: Align internal links, redirects, sitemap membership, and the declared canonical with the preferred URL.
GSC_USER_CANONICAL_NOT_SELECTED.message: Google selected a different canonical URL than the declared canonical

H1_ALT_TEXT_ONLY.fix: Add real, visible text to the H1 -- alt text describes an image to assistive technology, it is not a substitute for a heading a search engine reads as text.
H1_ALT_TEXT_ONLY.message: The H1 has no text of its own; its only content is an image's alt attribute

H1_DUPLICATE.fix: Use a unique, page-specific H1 on each URL.
H1_DUPLICATE.message: H1 is duplicated across multiple URLs

H1_LOW_SEMANTIC_RELEVANCE.fix: Review whether the heading describes the page's actual content and intent; the model score alone is not proof of irrelevance.
H1_LOW_SEMANTIC_RELEVANCE.message: H1 has low adapter-measured similarity to the page content; review candidate

H1_MISSING.fix: Add one H1 that clearly states the page topic.

H1_MULTIPLE.fix: Keep one primary H1 and demote the remaining headings to H2 or H3 as appropriate.
H1_MULTIPLE.message: Multiple H1 headings on the page

H1_ONLY_IN_RENDERED_HTML.fix: Serve the primary page heading in the original HTML response.
H1_ONLY_IN_RENDERED_HTML.message: H1 is present only after JavaScript rendering

H1_TOO_LONG.fix: Shorten the H1 while retaining the page's main topic.
H1_TOO_LONG.message: H1 exceeds the configured length threshold

H1_UPDATED_BY_JAVASCRIPT.fix: Keep the initial and rendered primary page heading aligned.

H2_DUPLICATE.fix: Use a unique, page-specific H2 on each URL, or accept it for a shared boilerplate subheading that is genuinely meant to repeat.
H2_DUPLICATE.message: H2 is duplicated across multiple URLs

H2_MISSING.fix: Add meaningful H2 subheadings where needed to structure the content.
H2_MISSING.message: Page has an H1 but no H2 headings

H2_MULTIPLE.fix: Multiple H2s are normal on structured pages; review the outline only when template furniture (menu labels, repeated card headings) dominates it and the page's own section headings drown.
H2_MULTIPLE.message: Page carries more than one H2 heading

H2_TOO_LONG.fix: Shorten the H2 while retaining what it introduces.
H2_TOO_LONG.message: H2 exceeds the configured length threshold

HEADING_BEFORE_H1.fix: Move the H1 above the headings that precede it, or demote those headings to plain text or a non-heading element. A parser reading the outline meets them before it meets the page's subject, and a snippet built from early page text quotes them instead of the page.
HEADING_BEFORE_H1.message: One or more headings appear before the page's first H1 in DOM order

HEADING_IN_PAGE_CHROME.fix: Mark template furniture up as what it is -- a menu label or a widget title is not a heading of this document, and repeating it on every page pushes the page's own headings down its outline.
HEADING_IN_PAGE_CHROME.message: A heading sits in the page chrome (header, nav, sidebar or footer) rather than in the content

HEADING_SKIP.fix: Use the adjacent heading level in both directions: an H4 that follows an H2 becomes H3, and a heading returning up the outline steps back one level at a time so each open section closes in order (H3 -> H2 closes one section and starts a sibling, which is correct nesting).
HEADING_SKIP.message: Content headings change by more than one level in DOM order, skipping a level down or jumping back up past an open section

HEAD_MISSING.fix: Add a <head> element; a browser inserts one implicitly, but every metadata tag then depends on exactly where it lands.

HEAD_MULTIPLE.fix: Merge into a single <head>; a browser keeps both as siblings rather than combining their contents.
HEAD_MULTIPLE.message: Document has more than one <head> element

HEAD_NOT_FIRST.fix: Fix the markup order so <head> opens immediately after <html>, before any <body> content.
HEAD_NOT_FIRST.message: <head> is not the first element under <html> once the parser resolves the document

HEAVY_NETWORK_PAYLOAD.fix: Reduce the page's heaviest captured subresources; the total sums every declared resource that was actually fetched, so a real visit with a warm cache may transfer less.
HEAVY_NETWORK_PAYLOAD.message: Captured page payload (document plus declared subresources) exceeds the configured content-decoded byte budget

HEAVY_PAGE_WEIGHT.fix: Reduce the measured document, images, fonts and scripts; keep raw-only and incomplete runtime coverage explicit.
HEAVY_PAGE_WEIGHT.message: Observed navigation responses or HTML alone exceed the configured content-decoded byte budget

HIGH_EXTERNAL_OUTLINKS.fix: Review the links for editorial relevance, spam, and unnecessary dilution of page focus.
HIGH_EXTERNAL_OUTLINKS.message: Page has a high number of external outlinks

HIGH_OUTLINKS.fix: Reduce unnecessary links to preserve clear navigation and crawl focus.
HIGH_OUTLINKS.message: Page has an excessive number of outlinks

HREFLANG_BROKEN_TARGET.fix: Update hreflang to reference the final 200-status URL; redirecting or broken targets undermine localization signals and crawling.
HREFLANG_BROKEN_TARGET.message: Hreflang points to a redirecting or broken URL (3xx, 4xx, or 5xx)

HREFLANG_ERROR.fix: Ensure hreflang annotations are reciprocal and reference canonical URLs.

HREFLANG_INCONSISTENT_CONFIRMATION.fix: Make the two declarations agree: either correct this page's hreflang value for that URL, or correct the counterpart's own self-referencing hreflang. Google reads a pair as valid only when both sides name the same code, so a mismatched pair is discarded exactly as a missing return link is.
HREFLANG_INCONSISTENT_CONFIRMATION.message: This page declares a counterpart under a language and region code the counterpart does not confirm for itself

HREFLANG_INVALID_CODE.fix: Use a valid language code, optionally followed by a valid region (e.g. en-GB, not en-UK).
HREFLANG_INVALID_CODE.message: Hreflang value is not a valid ISO 639-1 language / ISO 3166-1 region code

HREFLANG_MISSING_RETURN_LINK.fix: Add a reciprocal hreflang annotation back to every page that names this one.
HREFLANG_MISSING_RETURN_LINK.message: Another page's hreflang points here, but this page does not point back

HREFLANG_MISSING_SELF_REFERENCE.fix: Every page in an hreflang set must include a self-referencing annotation for its own URL and language.
HREFLANG_MISSING_SELF_REFERENCE.message: Page declares hreflang alternates but does not reference itself

HREFLANG_MISSING_XDEFAULT.fix: Add an x-default annotation to catch users whose language/region does not match any declared alternate.
HREFLANG_MISSING_XDEFAULT.message: Hreflang set has no x-default fallback

HREFLANG_MULTIPLE_ENTRIES.fix: Declare each language/region combination exactly once; conflicting duplicates make the annotation ambiguous.
HREFLANG_MULTIPLE_ENTRIES.message: The same hreflang value is declared more than once on the page

HREFLANG_NOINDEX_TARGET.fix: Use an indexable alternate URL or remove the noindex directive if that page should appear in search.
HREFLANG_NOINDEX_TARGET.message: Hreflang alternate points to an observed noindex page

HREFLANG_NOT_CANONICAL.fix: Point hreflang annotations at each target's canonical URL, not at a duplicate that canonicalizes elsewhere.
HREFLANG_NOT_CANONICAL.message: Hreflang points to a URL that is not itself the canonical version

HREFLANG_OUTSIDE_HEAD.fix: Move whatever precedes it in <head> — usually an element the head content model does not allow — so the alternate is read from <head> again.
HREFLANG_OUTSIDE_HEAD.message: An hreflang alternate link is outside <head> once the parser resolves the document

HREFLANG_UNLINKED_TARGET.fix: Add an ordinary internal link to the hreflang alternate, or confirm relying on the hreflang annotation alone for discovery is intentional.
HREFLANG_UNLINKED_TARGET.message: Hreflang alternate target has no hyperlink pointing to it anywhere in the crawl

HTML_BLOAT.fix: Reduce bytes per word by extracting styles and scripts, removing embedded base64 assets, and simplifying markup.
HTML_BLOAT.message: HTML bloat: high document size relative to text content

HTML_OVER_2MB.fix: Cut the document below 2 MB: remove inline data URIs and base64 assets, move inline CSS and scripts into cached files, and trim repeated markup.
HTML_OVER_2MB.message: HTML document is larger than 2 MB

HTTP1_ONLY.fix: Enable HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 on the origin server or CDN where supported.
HTTP1_ONLY.message: Response uses HTTP/1.x rather than HTTP/2 or newer

HTTP_LINK_ON_HTTPS.fix: Write the internal anchor as https:// or a relative URL. A fetched HTTP variant that already redirects to HTTPS is reported as converged, not as this finding.
HTTP_LINK_ON_HTTPS.message: HTTPS page contains an ordinary internal http:// anchor

HTTP_REFRESH_REDIRECT.fix: Replace it with a server-side 301/302 redirect (Location header); a search engine treats Refresh the same as a meta refresh -- an unreliable, delayed signal compared to a real HTTP redirect status code.
HTTP_REFRESH_REDIRECT.message: Redirect is implemented with an HTTP Refresh response header

HTTP_URL.fix: Serve the URL over HTTPS and redirect the HTTP version with a 301.
HTTP_URL.message: URL uses HTTP instead of HTTPS

IMAGE_DELIVERY.fix: Optimize the measured image size and encoding while preserving visual quality.
IMAGE_DELIVERY.message: The supplied Lighthouse image-delivery audit reports an opportunity

IMAGE_LINK_WITHOUT_TEXT.fix: Give the image a descriptive alt attribute, or add anchor text beside it. Neither a reader using a screen reader nor a crawler can tell what this link points to.
IMAGE_LINK_WITHOUT_TEXT.message: An image link carries no anchor text and no alt text, so nothing says where it goes

IMG_ALT_TOO_LONG.fix: Shorten the alt text to a concise description; screen readers read the whole string aloud, and a search engine treats an overlong alt as a weaker signal.
IMG_ALT_TOO_LONG.message: An image's alt text exceeds the configured length threshold

IMG_BROKEN.fix: Restore the file, or update the reference in the page template or CMS to a URL that answers 200.
IMG_BROKEN.message: Image URL answered with an HTTP error, so the browser shows nothing

IMG_INTRINSIC_OVERSIZED.fix: Serve a responsive image sized for the observed viewport and device pixel ratio.
IMG_INTRINSIC_OVERSIZED.message: A heavy image has more intrinsic width than its displayed device pixels need

IMG_MISSING_ALT.fix: Add concise, descriptive alt text when the image conveys content; use an empty alt attribute for decorative images.

IMG_MISSING_ALT_ATTRIBUTE.fix: Declare descriptive alt text for informative images, or alt="" for decoration. An ARIA name can label an image for assistive technology, but does not supply the missing alt attribute.
IMG_MISSING_ALT_ATTRIBUTE.message: An has no alt attribute at all (not even alt="")

IMG_MISSING_DIMENSIONS.fix: Declare intrinsic width and height values to reserve layout space and reduce CLS.
IMG_MISSING_DIMENSIONS.message: Image does not declare positive width and height attributes

IMG_OVER_KB.fix: Compress the image and consider converting it to WebP or AVIF while preserving acceptable visual quality.
IMG_OVER_KB.message: Image exceeds the configured file-size threshold

IMG_UPSCALED.fix: Supply an image with enough intrinsic pixels for the observed viewport and device pixel ratio.
IMG_UPSCALED.message: An image has less intrinsic width than its displayed device pixels need

IMPORTANT_URL_BLOCKED_BY_ROBOTS.fix: robots.txt blocks crawling, not indexing, so link discovery is lost. Make the URL crawlable with a more specific Allow rule than the matching Disallow, and control indexing with canonical or noindex. A common case is pagination such as /blog?page=N blocked by Disallow: /*?.
IMPORTANT_URL_BLOCKED_BY_ROBOTS.message: Live page is blocked by robots.txt despite receiving internal links

INLINK_BOILERPLATE_ONLY.fix: Add a contextual link to the page from relevant body copy; a page reachable only through boilerplate is not linked the way a page in the content graph is.
INLINK_BOILERPLATE_ONLY.message: Page is linked only from navigation, header, sidebar, or footer, never from body content

INSECURE_SUBRESOURCE.fix: Serve every page resource over HTTPS and update its URL accordingly.
INSECURE_SUBRESOURCE.message: An HTTPS page loads a resource (image, script, stylesheet, ...) over plain HTTP

INTERNALLY_LINKED_ROBOTS_BLOCKED.fix: Review the observed internal links and the blocking rule; allow crawling when this page should be discovered and indexed.
INTERNALLY_LINKED_ROBOTS_BLOCKED.message: An internally linked URL is blocked by robots.txt

INTERNAL_LINK_NO_ANCHOR.fix: Add descriptive text to the internal link, or provide an accessible label for an intentional image or icon link.
INTERNAL_LINK_NO_ANCHOR.message: Internal hyperlink has empty anchor text

INTERNAL_LINK_SPONSORED_UGC.fix: Remove sponsored and ugc from links to pages of this site. Keep them only on links that really lead to paid placements or user-submitted content.
INTERNAL_LINK_SPONSORED_UGC.message: An internal link carries rel=sponsored or rel=ugc

INTERNAL_LINK_TO_REDIRECT.fix: Point the link directly to the final URL to eliminate the unnecessary redirect hop.
INTERNAL_LINK_TO_REDIRECT.message: Internal link points to a redirect (3xx)

INTERNAL_NOFOLLOW_OUTLINKS.fix: Confirm each internal nofollow link is intentional; links to pages that should be crawled and ranked should be followed. rel=sponsored and rel=ugc are not visible here and stay distinct.
INTERNAL_NOFOLLOW_OUTLINKS.message: The page has internal outlinks marked nofollow

INVALID_CHARSET.fix: Declare UTF-8: a <meta charset="utf-8"> tag in the first 1024 bytes of the HTML, or charset=utf-8 in the Content-Type response header.
INVALID_CHARSET.message: The declared character encoding is not UTF-8

INVALID_DOCTYPE.fix: Replace the declaration with `<!DOCTYPE html>` — no PUBLIC or SYSTEM identifier.
INVALID_DOCTYPE.message: Document declares a legacy or malformed doctype instead of <!DOCTYPE html>, triggering quirks mode

INVALID_HEAD_ELEMENT.fix: Move title/base/link/meta/style/script/noscript/template content into <head> and everything else into <body>; an invalid element is what forces the parser to close <head> early.
INVALID_HEAD_ELEMENT.message: An element the head content model does not allow is written inside <head>

INVALID_LINK_TARGET.fix: Review each quoted href as written: a truncated or malformed URL passes no crawl equity and often signals a broken template; a non-http(s) scheme is only a finding when the link was meant to be a page. Recording is opt-in (discovery.record_invalid_targets); rejected targets never enter the crawl.
INVALID_LINK_TARGET.message: The page points at hrefs that cannot become fetchable link targets (unparsable syntax or a non-http(s) scheme)

INVALID_VIEWPORT.fix: Set the tag to `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`.
INVALID_VIEWPORT.message: The <meta name=viewport> tag names no usable width or an initial-scale below 1

JS_CONSOLE_ERRORS.fix: Fix the script error the console reports; an uncaught exception can stop the page's content, links or metadata from being built in the browser.
JS_CONSOLE_ERRORS.message: The page's browser console logged errors while it was rendered

JS_EXECUTION_TIME.fix: Reduce or defer the measured JavaScript execution work.
JS_EXECUTION_TIME.message: The supplied Lighthouse bootup-time audit reports expensive script execution

JS_REDIRECT.fix: Replace the script-initiated location change with a server-side 301/302 redirect where the move is permanent; a search engine only sees it after rendering, and anything that cannot run the script never moves at all.
JS_REDIRECT.message: Redirect is implemented with JavaScript (script-initiated navigation)

LARGE_HTML.fix: Reduce HTML size by removing unnecessary markup, extracting inline styles or scripts, and avoiding embedded base64 assets.
LARGE_HTML.message: HTML document is large in absolute terms or relative to the site

LAYOUT_SHIFT_CULPRITS.fix: Reserve layout space and correct the measured shift sources.
LAYOUT_SHIFT_CULPRITS.message: The supplied Lighthouse layout-shift audit reports culprits

LCP_DISCOVERY.fix: Review the recorded LCP element and make its image discoverable and appropriately prioritized.
LCP_DISCOVERY.message: The supplied Lighthouse LCP discovery audit reports an opportunity

LEGACY_JS.fix: Review target browser support before removing or splitting legacy code.
LEGACY_JS.message: Captured JavaScript has an unconditional legacy or polyfill marker (heuristic)

LINK_INSIDE_HEADING.fix: Let the heading describe this page and put the link in the body copy beneath it. A heading that is a link stops naming the page's own subject and starts pointing away from it.
LINK_INSIDE_HEADING.message: A heading on the page is, or contains, a link to somewhere else

LINK_TO_5XX.fix: Repair the destination page or remove the link.
LINK_TO_5XX.message: Internal link points to a 5xx URL

LONG_SENTENCES.fix: Break long sentences into shorter, focused statements.
LONG_SENTENCES.message: Average sentence length is too high

LOREM_IPSUM_PLACEHOLDER.fix: Replace the placeholder passage with real, reviewed copy before the page goes live or stays indexed.
LOREM_IPSUM_PLACEHOLDER.message: The Lorem Ipsum placeholder passage appears in the page's own content area

LOW_LINK_SCORE.fix: Add internal, followed links to the page from well-linked pages elsewhere on the site.
LOW_LINK_SCORE.message: Internal link score is far below the site median

LOW_RELEVANCE_CONTENT.fix: Review whether the heading describes the page's actual content; lexical overlap alone is not proof of relevance or irrelevance.
LOW_RELEVANCE_CONTENT.message: Title or H1 shares little vocabulary with the page's content area; review candidate

LOW_TEXT_RATIO.fix: Increase the proportion of meaningful visible content or reduce unnecessary markup; a page with enough words is not missing copy, only carrying a heavy template.
LOW_TEXT_RATIO.message: Low text-to-HTML ratio (a native crawl measures text against markup without script, style and JSON data blocks; pages above the thin-content word threshold are never reported)

META_DESCRIPTION_ONLY_IN_RENDERED_HTML.fix: Serve the meta description in the original HTML response.
META_DESCRIPTION_ONLY_IN_RENDERED_HTML.message: Meta description is present only after JavaScript rendering

META_DESCRIPTION_UPDATED_BY_JAVASCRIPT.fix: Keep the initial and rendered meta description aligned.
META_DESCRIPTION_UPDATED_BY_JAVASCRIPT.message: Meta description changes after JavaScript rendering

META_KEYWORDS_PRESENT.fix: Remove it if desired; modern search engines ignore meta keywords.
META_KEYWORDS_PRESENT.message: Obsolete meta keywords element is present

META_REFRESH_REDIRECT.fix: Replace meta refresh with a server-side 301 redirect when the move is permanent.
META_REFRESH_REDIRECT.message: Redirect is implemented with meta refresh

METRIKA_BOUNCE_RATE_ABOVE_70.fix: Review the measured URL and its traffic source; bounce rate is a diagnostic signal, not a ranking verdict.
METRIKA_BOUNCE_RATE_ABOVE_70.message: Yandex Metrika reports a bounce rate above 70 percent

METRIKA_ORPHAN_URL.fix: Check whether the URL is intentionally retired, blocked, redirected, or missing from the crawl population.
METRIKA_ORPHAN_URL.message: Yandex Metrika reports a landing URL absent from the crawl

MISSING_ABOUT_PAGE.fix: If an About page exists, make it reachable and indexable; the finding's state says whether it was found non-indexable, broken, linked but never crawled, or not discovered at all.
MISSING_ABOUT_PAGE.message: No indexable About page was found in the crawl's scope

MISSING_CHARSET.fix: Declare charset in the Content-Type response header, or add a <meta charset> tag in the first 1024 bytes of the HTML.
MISSING_CHARSET.message: No character encoding declared via Content-Type or an early <meta> tag

MISSING_CONTACT_PAGE.fix: If a Contact page exists, make it reachable and indexable; the finding's state says whether it was found non-indexable, broken, linked but never crawled, or not discovered at all.
MISSING_CONTACT_PAGE.message: No indexable Contact page was found in the crawl's scope

MISSING_CSP.fix: Send a Content-Security-Policy header that names the script and style sources the page uses.
MISSING_CSP.message: HTML page has no Content-Security-Policy header

MISSING_DOCTYPE.fix: Add `<!DOCTYPE html>` as the very first line of the document.
MISSING_DOCTYPE.message: Document has no doctype declaration, triggering quirks mode

MISSING_HSTS.fix: Add an appropriate Strict-Transport-Security header after confirming the entire site is HTTPS-ready.

MISSING_HSTS_ON_REDIRECT_HOP.fix: Send Strict-Transport-Security on every redirect response, including the www and http hosts a browser can arrive on; an upgrade hop without it leaves the first plain-HTTP request unprotected.
MISSING_HSTS_ON_REDIRECT_HOP.message: A redirect hop between the host variants of the start URL answers without HSTS

MISSING_PRIVACY_POLICY.fix: If a privacy policy exists, make it reachable and indexable; the finding's state says whether it was found non-indexable, broken, linked but never crawled, or not discovered at all.
MISSING_PRIVACY_POLICY.message: No indexable privacy policy page was found in the crawl's scope

MISSING_REFERRER_POLICY.fix: Send a Referrer-Policy header, for example strict-origin-when-cross-origin.
MISSING_REFERRER_POLICY.message: HTML page has no Referrer-Policy header

MISSING_TERMS_PAGE.fix: If a terms page exists, make it reachable and indexable; the finding's state says whether it was found non-indexable, broken, linked but never crawled, or not discovered at all.
MISSING_TERMS_PAGE.message: No indexable terms-of-use page was found in the crawl's scope

MISSING_X_CONTENT_TYPE_OPTIONS.fix: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff so browsers do not sniff the response into another type.
MISSING_X_CONTENT_TYPE_OPTIONS.message: HTML page has no X-Content-Type-Options header

MISSING_X_FRAME_OPTIONS.fix: Send X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN or a Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directive.
MISSING_X_FRAME_OPTIONS.message: HTML page has neither X-Frame-Options nor a CSP frame-ancestors directive

MIXED_CONTENT.fix: Serve every page resource over HTTPS and update its URL accordingly.
MIXED_CONTENT.message: Mixed content: HTTPS page loads resources over HTTP

MIXED_LINK_REL.fix: The combination is valid. Review whether each qualifying token describes the placement; retain intentional combinations and the full rel token set.
MIXED_LINK_REL.message: A link combines nofollow, sponsored or ugc tokens

MOBILE_ALTERNATE_LINK.fix: Give the mobile alternate link an `href` pointing at the mobile URL, or remove the `<link rel="alternate" media=...>` tag.
MOBILE_ALTERNATE_LINK.message: A <link rel=alternate media=...> declaration names no URL

MOBILE_CONTENT_OVERFLOW.fix: Constrain the overflowing element or provide a mobile-width layout.
MOBILE_CONTENT_OVERFLOW.message: Rendered content extends beyond the mobile viewport width

MOBILE_TARGET_TOO_SMALL.fix: Increase the interactive target's hit area and verify spacing at the target viewport.
MOBILE_TARGET_TOO_SMALL.message: Rendered interactive target is smaller than 48 CSS pixels in at least one dimension

MOBILE_TEXT_TOO_SMALL.fix: Use a readable mobile text size and verify the page at its target viewport.
MOBILE_TEXT_TOO_SMALL.message: Rendered text uses a computed font size below 12 CSS pixels

NEAR_DUPLICATE.fix: Differentiate the pages with substantive content or consolidate them into one canonical page.

NETWORK_DEPENDENCY_TREE.fix: Shorten the measured critical request chain; inspect the supplied lab trace evidence.
NETWORK_DEPENDENCY_TREE.message: The supplied Lighthouse dependency-tree audit reports a request-chain opportunity

NOARCHIVE.fix: Confirm that preventing cached search-result copies is intentional.

NOFOLLOW_ONLY_IN_RAW_HTML.fix: Keep link-following directives consistent in the original response and rendered document.
NOFOLLOW_ONLY_IN_RAW_HTML.message: Nofollow appears in the original HTML but not in the rendered DOM

NOFOLLOW_PAGE.fix: Confirm the directive is intentional and review its effect on crawling and internal link equity.

NOIMAGEINDEX.fix: Confirm that preventing images on this page from being indexed is intentional.

NOINDEX.fix: Confirm that exclusion from indexing is intentional.

NOINDEX_ONLY_IN_RAW_HTML.fix: Keep indexing directives consistent in the original response and rendered document.
NOINDEX_ONLY_IN_RAW_HTML.message: Noindex appears in the original HTML but not in the rendered DOM

NON_INDEXABLE_LINKED.fix: Decide whether the page should be indexable; otherwise remove unnecessary internal links and account for crawl-budget impact.

NON_INDEXABLE_WITH_GA_DATA.fix: Review whether the URL should be indexable; keep its current state only when that is intentional.
NON_INDEXABLE_WITH_GA_DATA.message: Non-indexable crawled URL has GA4 sessions

NON_INDEXABLE_WITH_METRIKA_DATA.fix: Review whether the URL should be indexable; keep its current state only when that is intentional.
NON_INDEXABLE_WITH_METRIKA_DATA.message: Non-indexable crawled URL has Yandex Metrika visits

NON_INDEXABLE_WITH_SEARCH_DATA.fix: Review the URL's indexability and canonical signals; keep the current state only when it is intentional.
NON_INDEXABLE_WITH_SEARCH_DATA.message: Non-indexable crawled URL has Search Console impressions

NOODP.fix: Remove the retired noodp directive; the Open Directory Project closed in 2017 and the directive has no effect.
NOODP.message: Page contains a legacy noodp directive

NOSNIPPET.fix: Confirm that suppressing the page's search-result snippet is intentional.

NOTRANSLATE.fix: Confirm that opting out of translation-related Google Search features is intentional.

NOYDIR.fix: Remove the retired noydir directive; the Yahoo Directory closed and the directive has no effect.
NOYDIR.message: Page contains a legacy noydir directive

NO_AUTHOR_BYLINE.fix: If the page's authorship should be attributable, declare it with a machine-readable carrier: meta author, rel=author, itemprop=author, or a JSON-LD author property.
NO_AUTHOR_BYLINE.message: Content-shaped page declares no author or byline markup

NO_COMPRESSION.fix: Enable gzip, Brotli, or deflate compression for text responses on the origin server or CDN.
NO_COMPRESSION.message: HTML response is served uncompressed above the size where gzip/br would help

NO_CONTENT_DATES.fix: If the page should be dated, declare it machine-readably: article:published_time or datePublished markup, a <time datetime> element, or a Last-Modified response header.
NO_CONTENT_DATES.message: Content-shaped page declares no publication or update date

NO_GA_DATA.fix: Review the measured period and analytics tagging before treating the absence as a page defect.
NO_GA_DATA.message: Indexable crawled URL has no retained GA4 sessions

NO_INTERNAL_OUTLINKS.fix: Add relevant internal links to help users and crawlers continue through the site.
NO_INTERNAL_OUTLINKS.message: Dead-end page has no internal outlinks

NO_METRIKA_DATA.fix: Review the measured period and Metrika tagging before treating the absence as a page defect.
NO_METRIKA_DATA.message: Indexable crawled URL has no retained Yandex Metrika visits

NO_RESPONSE.fix: Check host availability, DNS resolution, connectivity, and timeout settings.
NO_RESPONSE.message: No response (timeout, DNS, or connection failure)

NO_SEARCH_DATA.fix: Review indexing, canonicalization, demand, and the measured reporting window before changing the page.
NO_SEARCH_DATA.message: Indexable crawled URL has no retained Search Console impressions

OG_MISSING.fix: Add og:title, og:image, and og:url; at minimum, provide og:title and og:image for a useful preview.
OG_MISSING.message: og:title is missing, so social previews may not render correctly

ONLY_NOFOLLOW_INLINKS.fix: Add at least one ordinary, followed internal link so link equity and crawl priority reach the page.
ONLY_NOFOLLOW_INLINKS.message: Every internal link to this page is nofollow

ONLY_NONINDEXABLE_SOURCE_INLINKS.fix: Link to the page from at least one indexable page so it is reachable from the part of the site search engines actually rank.
ONLY_NONINDEXABLE_SOURCE_INLINKS.message: Every internal link to this page comes from a non-indexable source

ORPHAN_PAGE.fix: Add relevant internal links so users and crawlers can discover the page.
ORPHAN_PAGE.message: Orphan page has no internal inlinks

OUTBOUND_SPONSORED_WITHOUT_DISCLOSURE.fix: Review the retained local text and add a clear reader-facing disclosure when needed. This bounded English/Russian text-marker heuristic does not establish legal compliance; CSS visibility, other languages and remote disclosures require manual review.
OUTBOUND_SPONSORED_WITHOUT_DISCLOSURE.message: An outbound sponsored link has no recognized local disclosure text

OUTLINK_TO_LOCALHOST.fix: Replace the development/staging reference with the production URL.
OUTLINK_TO_LOCALHOST.message: A link points at a loopback address (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, ...)

PAGE_TITLE_ONLY_IN_RENDERED_HTML.fix: Serve the page title in the original HTML response.
PAGE_TITLE_ONLY_IN_RENDERED_HTML.message: Page title is present only after JavaScript rendering

PAGE_TITLE_UPDATED_BY_JAVASCRIPT.fix: Keep the initial and rendered page title aligned.
PAGE_TITLE_UPDATED_BY_JAVASCRIPT.message: Page title changes after JavaScript rendering

PAGINATION_CANONICAL_POLICY.fix: Review the canonical against the configured pagination policy; the expected target is included in the evidence.
PAGINATION_CANONICAL_POLICY.message: Paginated URL canonical does not match the configured project policy

PAGINATION_LOOP.fix: Fix the rel="next"/rel="prev" values so the series terminates instead of cycling.
PAGINATION_LOOP.message: A rel="next" pagination series loops back on itself

PAGINATION_MULTIPLE.fix: Declare exactly one rel="next" and one rel="prev" URL per page; two different successors leave the series ambiguous, and a crawler picks one of them without telling anybody which.
PAGINATION_MULTIPLE.message: The page declares more than one rel="next" (or more than one rel="prev") URL

PAGINATION_NONINDEXABLE.fix: Pagination pages should generally remain crawlable and indexable unless a deliberate alternative architecture is in place.

PAGINATION_SEQUENCE_ERROR.fix: Point each rel="next" at the page that actually follows this one. A run that goes 1, 2, 3, 7 leaves pages 4 to 6 out of the chain entirely, so a crawler following it never reaches them.
PAGINATION_SEQUENCE_ERROR.message: Pagination breaks an established numbered run or contradicts a reciprocal next/prev declaration

PAGINATION_URL_NOT_IN_ANCHOR.fix: Link the paginated URL from the page itself with an ordinary <a href> as well. Google stopped using rel="next"/rel="prev" for indexing in 2019, so an annotation with no anchor beside it is a route only some crawlers still take.
PAGINATION_URL_NOT_IN_ANCHOR.message: A rel="next"/rel="prev" URL is not also linked from the same page with an anchor

PLACEHOLDER_MARKER.fix: Replace the observed marker with reviewed page-specific copy. This check only reports explicit bracketed template tokens, not ordinary wording such as 'coming soon'.
PLACEHOLDER_MARKER.message: Page declaration contains a literal TODO, TBD, or placeholder template marker

PROTOCOL_RELATIVE_LINK.fix: Write an explicit https:// href; a protocol-relative one silently follows whatever scheme served the current page, including a plain-HTTP embed.
PROTOCOL_RELATIVE_LINK.message: Link href is written in the protocol-relative "//host/path" form

READABILITY_DIFFICULT.fix: Use clearer wording and shorter sentences while preserving technical accuracy.
READABILITY_DIFFICULT.message: Text is difficult to read (low Flesch score)

REDIRECT_CHAIN.fix: Replace the chain with a single 301 redirect to the final URL.
REDIRECT_CHAIN.message: Redirect chain contains two or more hops

REDIRECT_LOOP.fix: Break the redirect cycle so every redirect path terminates at a valid destination.

RENDER_BLOCKING.fix: Add `defer` or `async` to the <script src>, move it out of <head>, or give the stylesheet a `media` value that the first render does not need.
RENDER_BLOCKING.message: A <head> script or stylesheet blocks first paint (no async/defer, no non-matching media)

RENDER_RESOURCE_BLOCKED.fix: Review the recorded request reason and make required page resources available to the renderer.
RENDER_RESOURCE_BLOCKED.message: A rendered page resource was refused or returned an HTTP error

RESOURCE_OVER_2MB.fix: Reduce or split the identified resource; the default budget is 2 MiB.
RESOURCE_OVER_2MB.message: A captured resource exceeds the configured individual byte budget

ROBOTS_BLOCKED_OUTLINK.fix: Review the Disallow rules that hid the quoted targets: a rule broad enough to block an internal link target removes that section from every robots-respecting crawler. Confirm each blocked target is intentionally excluded, or narrow the rule so the pages can be crawled and indexed on their own merits.
ROBOTS_BLOCKED_OUTLINK.message: The page links to URLs the crawl's robots policy kept out of the crawl

ROBOTS_BLOCKS_RESOURCES.fix: Do not block .js, .css, or _next/static resources in robots.txt; otherwise Google may render the page incompletely.
ROBOTS_BLOCKS_RESOURCES.message: robots.txt blocks JavaScript or CSS resources required for rendering

SCHEMA_VALIDATION_ERROR.fix: Correct invalid JSON-LD or Microdata markup and retest it against the applicable vocabulary and rich-result requirements.

SEMANTICALLY_SIMILAR.fix: Review intent and useful internal linking. Lexical similarity alone does not prove duplicate content, cannibalization or topical equivalence.
SEMANTICALLY_SIMILAR.message: Pages have high lexical similarity in their content areas; review candidate

SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY_CANDIDATE.fix: Review intent and useful internal linking. Semantic similarity alone does not prove duplicate content or cannibalization.
SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY_CANDIDATE.message: Pages have adapter-measured topical similarity; review candidate

SERVER_ERROR_5XX.fix: Investigate the server or application; this error makes the page unavailable to users and crawlers.

SITEMAP_DESYNC.fix: Synchronize the sitemap with the site's actual set of canonical, indexable pages.
SITEMAP_DESYNC.message: Sitemap and crawl URL sets are out of sync

SITEMAP_FETCH_INCOMPLETE.fix: Check that every child sitemap is reachable, retry in case the service was temporarily slow, and validate the XML -- a 200 response with malformed markup (e.g. an unescaped '&' in a URL) fails here the same way a network error does.
SITEMAP_FETCH_INCOMPLETE.message: Some child sitemaps could not be fetched or parsed

SITEMAP_NOT_IN_ROBOTS.fix: Add a Sitemap directive to robots.txt with the absolute sitemap URL.
SITEMAP_NOT_IN_ROBOTS.message: robots.txt does not declare a Sitemap directive

SITEMAP_ORPHAN.fix: Add relevant internal links to the page or remove it from the sitemap if it should not be discoverable.
SITEMAP_ORPHAN.message: Sitemap URL has no internal inlinks

SITEMAP_STALE_LASTMOD.fix: Generate each lastmod value from the page's actual meaningful modification date.
SITEMAP_STALE_LASTMOD.message: Sitemap contains stale or boilerplate lastmod values

SITEMAP_TOO_LARGE.fix: Split the sitemap so each file stays under 50 MB uncompressed. The limit is about the document a search engine parses, so compressing it does not help.
SITEMAP_TOO_LARGE.message: Sitemap exceeds the protocol's uncompressed size limit

SITEMAP_TOO_MANY_URLS.fix: Split the sitemap into files of at most 50,000 URLs each and list them in a sitemap index. Over the limit the file is invalid and a search engine may read part of it and discard the rest without reporting anything.
SITEMAP_TOO_MANY_URLS.message: Sitemap declares more URLs than the protocol allows

SITEMAP_URL_3XX.fix: List the final 200-status URL in the sitemap instead of a redirecting URL.

SITEMAP_URL_4XX_5XX.fix: Remove broken URLs from the sitemap or restore them before listing them again.
SITEMAP_URL_4XX_5XX.message: Sitemap URL returns a 4xx or 5xx response

SITEMAP_URL_BLOCKED_ROBOTS.fix: Remove the intentionally blocked URL from the sitemap or allow crawling if the URL should be indexed.
SITEMAP_URL_BLOCKED_ROBOTS.message: Sitemap URL is blocked by the retained robots policy

SITEMAP_URL_DUPLICATED.fix: Declare each URL in exactly one sitemap. A URL in two files is usually a generator that ran twice, and it distorts every count taken from the declared set.
SITEMAP_URL_DUPLICATED.message: URL is declared in more than one sitemap

SITEMAP_URL_NON_CANONICAL.fix: List the canonical destination in the sitemap and remove the non-canonical URL.
SITEMAP_URL_NON_CANONICAL.message: Sitemap URL declares another canonical URL

SITEMAP_URL_NON_INDEXABLE.fix: Keep only canonical, indexable URLs in the sitemap.

SLOW_RESPONSE.fix: Improve TTFB by profiling the application and origin, then optimizing caching and infrastructure.

SPELLING_ERRORS.fix: Review and correct spelling errors, accounting for valid product names and specialist terminology.

STRUCTURED_DATA_MISSING.fix: Add relevant, accurate Schema.org markup that reflects visible page content.

STRUCTURED_DATA_PARSE_ERROR.fix: Fix the malformed JSON-LD block (a stray comma, an unescaped quote, or an unclosed brace commonly voids the whole block); a search engine ignores structured data it cannot parse the same as if none were present.
STRUCTURED_DATA_PARSE_ERROR.message: A JSON-LD block is present but did not parse as valid JSON

STRUCTURED_DATA_RICH_RESULT_REQUIRED_MIS.fix: Fill the required properties for the declared type and validate the result; local eligibility does not guarantee Google display.
STRUCTURED_DATA_RICH_RESULT_REQUIRED_MIS.message: Structured data lacks required properties in the bundled local rich-result rules

STRUCTURED_DATA_SCHEMA_ERROR.fix: Inspect the URL schema evidence and repair unknown types, properties, invalid values or unresolved references.
STRUCTURED_DATA_SCHEMA_ERROR.message: Structured data contains errors under the bundled Schema.org vocabulary

STRUCTURED_DATA_SCHEMA_WARNING.fix: Review the URL schema evidence and correct ambiguous values or graph relationships.
STRUCTURED_DATA_SCHEMA_WARNING.message: Structured data contains warnings under the bundled Schema.org vocabulary

THIN_CONTENT.fix: Add substantial, useful content or exclude the page from indexing when it has no standalone search value.

TITLE_DUPLICATE.fix: Give each page a unique title element.

TITLE_EQUALS_H1.fix: Differentiate the title and H1 by purpose, wording, or keyword emphasis.
TITLE_EQUALS_H1.message: Title is identical to the H1

TITLE_LOW_SEMANTIC_RELEVANCE.fix: Review whether the title describes the page's actual content and intent; the model score alone is not proof of irrelevance.
TITLE_LOW_SEMANTIC_RELEVANCE.message: Title has low adapter-measured similarity to the page content; review candidate

TITLE_MISSING.fix: Add a unique, descriptive title element.

TITLE_MULTIPLE.fix: Keep exactly one <title> element in the document head.

TITLE_OUTSIDE_HEAD.fix: Move whatever precedes it in <head> — usually an element the head content model does not allow — so <title> is read from <head> again.
TITLE_OUTSIDE_HEAD.message: The <title> element is outside <head> once the parser resolves the document

TITLE_PIXELS_BELOW.fix: Expand the title so it uses the available SERP width informatively.
TITLE_PIXELS_BELOW.message: Title falls below the configured SERP pixel-width threshold

TITLE_PIXELS_OVER.fix: Shorten or reword the title; SERP truncation follows rendered pixel width, not the character count.
TITLE_PIXELS_OVER.message: Title exceeds the configured SERP pixel-width threshold

TITLE_TEMPLATED.fix: Make the page-specific portion of each title distinctive; a shared brand suffix is acceptable, but duplicated core title text is not.
TITLE_TEMPLATED.message: Templated titles share a common prefix or suffix across most pages

TITLE_TOO_LONG.fix: Shorten the title to fit the configured character limit.
TITLE_TOO_LONG.message: Title exceeds the configured length threshold

TITLE_TOO_SHORT.fix: Expand the title to an informative length without padding it with boilerplate.
TITLE_TOO_SHORT.message: Title falls below the configured length threshold

UNAVAILABLE_AFTER.fix: Confirm the date is intentional and in the future; once it passes, the page is removed from the index automatically.
UNAVAILABLE_AFTER.message: Page carries an unavailable_after directive with a deindex date

UNLINKED_CANONICAL.fix: Add an ordinary internal link to the canonical target, or confirm relying on the canonical alone for discovery is intentional.
UNLINKED_CANONICAL.message: Canonical target has no hyperlink pointing to it anywhere in the crawl

UNLINKED_PAGINATION_SERIES.fix: Add an ordinary internal link to the first page of the series so it does not depend on rel="next" alone for discovery.
UNLINKED_PAGINATION_SERIES.message: A pagination series is reachable only by following rel="next", never by a hyperlink

UNMINIFIED_CSS_JS.fix: Apply the existing production minifier and verify the result still works.
UNMINIFIED_CSS_JS.message: Captured CSS or JavaScript does not look minified (heuristic)

UNSAFE_CROSS_ORIGIN_LINK.fix: Add rel="noopener" (or "noreferrer") so the opened page cannot reach back into this one through window.opener.
UNSAFE_CROSS_ORIGIN_LINK.message: A target="_blank" link declares neither rel="noopener" nor rel="noreferrer"

UNSUPPORTED_PLUGIN.fix: Replace the plugin-dependent element with a native equivalent (HTML5
UNSUPPORTED_PLUGIN.message: Page contains a legacy plugin-dependent element (<object>/<embed>/<applet>)

UNUSED_CSS_JS.fix: Split or defer unused code after testing the interactions and routes that need it; lab coverage is not proof code is universally unused.
UNUSED_CSS_JS.message: CSS or JavaScript source is substantially unused in the captured navigation window

URL_CONTAINS_SPACE.fix: Encode literal spaces in links; do not mechanically remove percent-encoded values such as q=red%20shoes. Change a canonical path only after verifying equivalent content and planning redirects or canonicals.

URL_HAS_PARAMETERS.fix: Review whether the parameters create unique indexable content; keep internal links and sitemaps on the parameter-free URL where they do not.

URL_HAS_PARAMS.fix: Point the canonical to the preferred parameter-free URL when the parameters do not create unique indexable content.

URL_INTERNAL_SEARCH.fix: Review whether internal search results should be linked or indexable; apply the intended crawl and indexing policy.
URL_INTERNAL_SEARCH.message: URL is a recognized internal search route

URL_MULTIPLE_SLASHES.fix: Remove duplicate slashes and 301-redirect the malformed variant to the canonical path.

URL_NON_ASCII.fix: Consider a consistent ASCII transliteration for human-readable URLs where appropriate.

URL_NOT_IN_SITEMAP.fix: Add the canonical page URL to the appropriate sitemap.
URL_NOT_IN_SITEMAP.message: Indexable page is missing from the sitemap

URL_REPETITIVE_PATH.fix: Simplify the URL structure so path segments are not duplicated.
URL_REPETITIVE_PATH.message: URL path contains a repeated segment

URL_SESSION_ID.fix: Prevent session identifiers from entering crawlable URLs and consolidate any indexed variants; the finding retains parameter names but redacts their values.
URL_SESSION_ID.message: Indexable URL contains a recognized session-token parameter

URL_TOO_LONG.fix: Shorten the URL while preserving a stable, descriptive path.
URL_TOO_LONG.message: URL exceeds the configured length threshold

URL_TRACKING_PARAMS.fix: Remove tracking parameters from public links; for parameterized URLs that still receive traffic, add a self-referencing canonical or manage crawling through robots.txt and Search Console as appropriate.
URL_TRACKING_PARAMS.message: Indexable URL contains a tracking parameter such as utm_, gclid, or fbclid

URL_TRAILING_SLASH_INCONSISTENT.fix: Choose and implement a documented URL policy if both variants are not intentional; redirect or canonical convergence already observed is not reported.
URL_TRAILING_SLASH_INCONSISTENT.message: Comparable trailing-slash URL variants both serve as separate indexable pages

URL_UNDERSCORES.fix: Use hyphens instead of underscores in URL path segments.

URL_UPPERCASE.fix: Normalize the path to lowercase and add a 301 redirect from the uppercase variant.

VIEWPORT_MISSING.fix: Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` to the document head.

YMYL_REVIEW_CANDIDATE.fix: Have a specialist confirm whether the page genuinely covers Your-Money-Your-Life topics; if it does, the attribution and trust-page evidence above deserves a closer look.
YMYL_REVIEW_CANDIDATE.message: URL path or title matches a YMYL-adjacent keyword — a review candidate only, not a classification
